en.text: He always keeps his word.

original: 何が何でも約束は守るよ。

en.text: No matter what happens, I'll keep my promise.

original: 私たちは、身を守る方法を子供たちに教えるべきです。

en.text: We should teach children how to protect themselves.

original: 時間はちゃんと守った方がいいよ。

en.text: I advise you to be punctual.

original: 約束を守ることは大切だと思うよ。

en.text: I think it's important to keep promises.

original: 守りたい、この笑顔。

en.text: I want to protect this smile.

original: 約束は守って欲しい。

en.text: I want you to keep your promise.

original: 約束は守るよ。

en.text: I keep my word.
I'll keep my promise.

original: 政治家は公約を守るべきです。

en.text: Politicians should keep their promises.

original: フィンランドの公共交通機関は時間を正確に守る。

en.text: In Finland public transport is always on time.

original: トム、約束守ると思う？

en.text: Do you think Tom will keep his promise?
Do you think that Tom will keep his promise?

original: 約束は守った方がいいよ。

en.text: You should keep your word.
You should keep your promises.

original: 彼は彼女を守ってと頼んだ。

en.text: He asked me to protect her.
